At which station do they transfer? Answer with the station name exactly as printed on the map.

Answer the question using the image. Think it through, then give the answer exactly as written on the map (just the name, nothing else).

content:
**Chambers St** is the transfer point.

Fulton St is served by the J train, which runs north to Chambers St, one stop away. The J at Chambers St is joined by a free walking transfer to the Brooklyn Bridge-City Hall station, which is the destination. That makes one transfer and one station stop along the way. The alternative, riding the J two stops to Canal St and transferring to the 6, takes two stops, so it loses.

I read the walking connection as completing the trip, even though the rules say the trip should end when a train arrives. That reading is the main assumption here.

FINAL ANSWER: Chambers St
